name: @shruti/share-video
description: Serverless function that renders short-form video reels. Cuts audio, transcribes via Whisper, force-aligns caller text, overlays on themed S3 background pack, appends bundled logo, uploads to S3. Deploys to AWS Lambda and Yandex Cloud Functions.

scripts.deploy:aws: npm run build && serverless deploy --config serverless-aws.yml
scripts.deploy:yc: npm run build && serverless deploy --config serverless-yc.yml
